description: Source code implementing functions for netlink socket communication and wireless interface management, including initialization, messaging, and multicast subscription, specifically for nl80211 wireless device interactions.

methods.name: unl_init
methods.description: Initializes the unl structure by allocating a netlink socket.

methods.name: unl_genl_init
methods.description: Initializes the unl structure with a specified family name, setting up netlink communication and family info.

methods.name: unl_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the unl structure, including socket, cache, and family name.

methods.name: unl_genl_msg
methods.description: Creates a new netlink message for a specified command, optionally for dumping data.

methods.name: unl_genl_request
methods.description: Sends a netlink request with a callback handler for processing responses.

methods.name: unl_genl_request_single
methods.description: Sends a request expecting a single reply message.

methods.name: unl_genl_loop
methods.description: Enters a loop to receive and handle netlink messages until a condition is met.

methods.name: unl_genl_multicast_id
methods.description: Retrieves the multicast group ID for a given group name.

methods.name: unl_genl_subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a multicast group by name.

methods.name: unl_genl_unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a multicast group by name.

methods.name: unl_nl80211_phy_lookup
methods.description: Looks up the physical device index for a given wireless interface name.

methods.name: unl_nl80211_wdev_to_phy
methods.description: Converts a wireless device index to a physical device index.
